# AI Trail Tracker — Feature Specification

## 1. Overview

The AI Trail Tracker is a web application for tracking individual developer progress through the AI Trail program. It provides a personal dashboard for developers to view their current badge level, complete activities, submit evidence, and request advancement. An admin interface allows Trail leadership to review submissions, monitor participant progress, and approve badge advancement.

## 2. User Roles

| Role | Description | Authentication |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| **Developer** | Any engineer participating in the AI Trail program | Azure AD (MS principal from session cookie/token) |
| **Admin** | AI Trail leadership who review and approve badge advancement | Azure AD with admin role claim |

### Role Determination

- All authenticated users default to the **Developer** role.
- **Admin** role is determined by membership in a configured Azure AD group or a role claim in the token.
- Admins retain full Developer capabilities (they can also track their own progress).

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1 Developer Experience

#### 3.1.1 Home / Dashboard Page

**Route:** `/`

The landing page after login displays the developer's personal progress dashboard.

| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Current Badge Level** | Prominently displayed badge: Greenhorn, Wayfinder, Trail Guide, or Pioneer with visual badge icon |
| **Progress Overview** | Progress bar or visual indicator showing completion percentage of current level's exit criteria |
| **Current Level Activities** | Expandable sections for each category of expectations at the current level |
| **Exit Criteria Checklist** | Checklist of exit criteria for the current level with completion status |
| **Training Links** | Links to external training resources relevant to the current level |
| **Guild Info** | Current guild membership and meeting schedule |

#### 3.1.2 Activity Details & Evidence Submission

For each exit criterion at the current badge level, the developer can:

1. **View requirements** — See the full description of what is required
2. **Provide evidence links** — Enter URLs (GitHub repos, branch links, training completion screenshots, Webex recordings) in text input fields
3. **Add notes** — Optional free-text field for additional context
4. **Save progress** — Evidence can be saved incrementally without submitting
5. **View status** — See whether each criterion is: Not Started, In Progress, Evidence Submitted, Approved, or Rejected

#### 3.1.3 Submit for Review

- Once all exit criteria for a level have evidence attached, a **"Submit for Review"** button becomes enabled.
- Submitting locks the evidence for that level (no further edits until admin action).
- Developer receives visual confirmation of submission.
- If an admin rejects a criterion, the developer is notified and can update the evidence and resubmit.

#### 3.1.4 Badge Level Activities — Detailed Breakdown

**Level 1: Greenhorn — Exit Criteria**

| # | Criterion | Evidence Type |
|---|-----------|---------------|
| 1 | Use GitHub Copilot and Agent OS to deliver a sample application | GitHub branch URL |
| 2 | Complete the AI-First SDLC Training | Training completion confirmation |
| 3 | Deliver 5 stories using Agent Mode | Links/descriptions for 5 stories |

**Level 2: Wayfinder — Exit Criteria**

| # | Criterion | Evidence Type |
|---|-----------|---------------|
| 1 | Training completion (GH-300T00-A or equivalent) | Training certificate/completion link |
| 2 | 80% AI-assisted delivery (30+ stories over 3 months) | Story links / metrics summary |
| 3 | Repository configuration | GitHub links to repo agent instructions |
| 4 | AI Research (3 Webex recordings) | 3 Webex recording URLs |
| 5 | AI Guild participation | Attendance evidence / guild lead confirmation |

**Level 3: Trail Guide — Exit Criteria**

| # | Criterion | Evidence Type |
|---|-----------|---------------|
| 1 | Automated code delivery pipeline | Pipeline link / demo recording |
| 2 | Multi-agent development setup | Evidence of multi-agent configuration |
| 3 | Lead a guild of 5+ engineers | Guild roster / attendance logs |

**Level 4: Pioneer**

Pioneer has no formal exit criteria. The dashboard displays ongoing expectations and allows Pioneers to log activities.

#### 3.1.5 Training Links Section

Each badge level displays relevant training links organized by category. Links open in new browser tabs. Training links are configured server-side and served via API.

Categories per level include:
- Environment Setup
- Training Materials
- Context Engineering
- Quality Control
- Advanced Topics

### 3.2 Admin Experience

#### 3.2.1 Admin Dashboard

**Route:** `/admin`

Accessible only to users with the Admin role. Displays:

| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Pending Reviews** | List of developers who have submitted evidence for review, ordered by submission date |
| **Participant List** | Searchable/filterable list of all participants with current badge level |
| **Progress Overview** | Aggregate stats: count of engineers at each badge level, percentage toward Wayfinder goal |
| **Guild Overview** | List of guilds with member counts |

#### 3.2.2 Review Submissions

When an admin opens a pending submission:

1. **View all evidence** — See every criterion with the developer's submitted links/notes
2. **Approve / Reject per criterion** — Each criterion can be individually approved or rejected
3. **Add feedback** — Text field for comments on rejection (required when rejecting)
4. **Approve Level** — Once all criteria are approved, admin clicks "Approve Level Advancement"

#### 3.2.3 Level Advancement

Upon full approval:

- Developer's badge level is incremented (Greenhorn → Wayfinder → Trail Guide → Pioneer)
- Timestamp of advancement is recorded
- Developer sees the new level on their next dashboard visit
- Previous level's evidence is retained as historical record

#### 3.2.4 Participant Detail View

Admins can view any participant's full profile:

- Current badge level
- All completed levels with evidence and approval dates
- Current level progress
- Guild membership
- Submission history

### 3.3 Navigation

| Route | Component | Access |
|-------|-----------|--------|
| `/` | Developer Dashboard | All authenticated users |
| `/admin` | Admin Dashboard | Admin role only |
| `/admin/review/:userId` | Review Submission | Admin role only |
| `/admin/participant/:userId` | Participant Detail | Admin role only |

### 3.4 Security Requirements

1. **Authentication** — Azure AD only; all routes require authentication except health check endpoints
2. **Authorization** — Admin routes require admin role; developer routes accessible to all authenticated users
3. **Data isolation** — Developers can only view/edit their own data; admins can view all data
4. **Evidence integrity** — Submitted evidence is locked until admin action (approve/reject)
5. **Input validation** — All URL inputs validated for format; free-text fields sanitized against XSS
6. **CSRF protection** — Anti-forgery tokens on all mutating operations
7. **Local development bypass** — Authentication is bypassed when running locally (development mode) and during unit tests; a mock user principal is injected

## 4. User Stories

### Developer Stories

| ID | Story | Acceptance Criteria |
|----|-------|---------------------|
| US-01 | As a developer, I want to see my current badge level on the dashboard so I know where I stand | Dashboard shows badge name, icon, and level number |
| US-02 | As a developer, I want to see all remaining activities for my current level so I know what to work on | Activities listed with completion status |
| US-03 | As a developer, I want to enter evidence links for each exit criterion so I can prove completion | Text inputs accept and validate URLs; save persists data |
| US-04 | As a developer, I want to save my progress incrementally so I don't lose partial work | Save button persists without requiring full submission |
| US-05 | As a developer, I want to submit my completed level for review so an admin can approve advancement | Submit button enabled when all criteria have evidence; submission locks edits |
| US-06 | As a developer, I want to see training links relevant to my current level so I can access resources | Links displayed per category, open in new tab |
| US-07 | As a developer, I want to see my submission status so I know if I'm approved or need to revise | Status indicators per criterion: Pending, Approved, Rejected |
| US-08 | As a developer, I want to update rejected evidence and resubmit so I can address admin feedback | Rejected criteria unlock for editing; resubmit re-locks |

### Admin Stories

| ID | Story | Acceptance Criteria |
|----|-------|---------------------|
| US-09 | As an admin, I want to see a list of pending submissions so I can review them | Pending list sorted by submission date |
| US-10 | As an admin, I want to review each criterion's evidence so I can approve or reject it | Per-criterion approve/reject buttons with evidence display |
| US-11 | As an admin, I want to provide feedback when rejecting a criterion so the developer knows what to fix | Required comment field on rejection |
| US-12 | As an admin, I want to approve a full level so the developer advances to the next badge | "Approve Level" button enabled when all criteria approved; developer level incremented |
| US-13 | As an admin, I want to view any participant's progress so I can monitor the program | Searchable participant list with detail view |
| US-14 | As an admin, I want to see aggregate program stats so I can track toward the Wayfinder goal | Dashboard shows counts per level and percentage progress |

## 5. Scope

### In Scope

- Developer dashboard with badge progress tracking
- Evidence submission with URL text inputs
- Admin review and approval workflow
- Badge level advancement upon approval
- Azure AD authentication with local dev bypass
- Azure Table Storage with in-memory fallback
- React + Vite + MUI frontend
- .NET 10 Web API backend
- Training links display per level

### Out of Scope (Future)

- Email/notification system for approvals and rejections
- Guild management (create, join, leave guilds)
- Story/delivery metrics integration (automated pull from ADO/GitHub)
- Team Badges (Base Camp 1, Base Camp 2, Summit)
- Partner Badges for non-engineering roles
- Train-a-Thon event management
- File upload for evidence (only URL links for now)
- Reporting/export functionality
